# Command reference

## check

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 check [-h] [--ci] [--json] [--root ROOT] [--project PROJECT]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --ci               no-op today; makes CI intent explicit (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md Phase 3)
  --json             emit one JSON report instead of text
  --root ROOT        store root directory (default: current directory)
  --project PROJECT  project root for acceptance-pack file verification (default: parent of --root
                     when its basename is .vouch)
```

## formal

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 formal [-h] [--root ROOT] [--record]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  store root directory (required with --record)
  --record     record the passing formal certificate in the store
```

## upgrade

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 upgrade [-h] [--root ROOT] [--dry-run] [--was-published NAME@V]
                         [--never-published NAME@V]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           store root directory (default: current directory)
  --dry-run             show required format steps without changing the store
  --was-published NAME@V
                        assert that an ambiguous legacy unit was previously published
  --never-published NAME@V
                        assert that an ambiguous legacy unit was never published
```

## emit-context

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 emit-context [-h] [--root ROOT] [--target TARGET]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT      store root directory (default: current directory)
  --target TARGET  optional caller-chosen context target path
```

## build-lock

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 build-lock [-h] --output OUTPUT

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT  lock output path
```

## self-check

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 self-check [-h] [--expect EXPECT]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --expect EXPECT  a 64-hex digest, or @PATH to a config.json carrying lock_digest; exit 1 unless
                   the running lock's digest matches
```

## init

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 init [-h] --project PROJECT [--lock LOCK_PATH]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT  target project directory
  --lock LOCK_PATH   existing lock to vendor instead of building/copying the running code
```

## mcp

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 mcp [-h] --root ROOT

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  the store root this server is pinned to (tools take no root)
```

## hook

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 hook [-h] [--edit-target EDIT_TARGET]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --edit-target EDIT_TARGET
                        edited file or directory; absent reads tool_input.file_path from stdin
                        JSON
```

## migrate

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 migrate [-h] --ledger LEDGER [--anchor-mode {none,ci}] [--config CONFIG]
                         [--drop-qualified] [--approve] [--target TARGET]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ledger LEDGER       0.6 ledger JSON path
  --anchor-mode {none,ci}
                        mk2 anchor mode (overrides --config)
  --config CONFIG       optional 0.6 config.json carrying anchor.mode and its legacy tier
  --drop-qualified      report and omit unrepresentable qualified releases
  --approve             write the validated candidate to a fresh target/.vouch
  --target TARGET       existing target project directory (required with --approve)
```
